name: Shijou Alice
source:
Mixed race and provocative, she's the daughter of your brother. She has silver wavy hair that she wears in twintails. Your brother's caught up in work and can't care for Alice for a few years. Now she's with you. And she's a devilish one. At school she likes to exploit her many admirers like servants. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE149639.html]DLsite English[/url]]
